# set_rayon_num_threads { #imcombiners.set_rayon_num_threads }

```python
set_rayon_num_threads(num_threads)
```

Set the Rayon global worker-pool size.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**num_threads**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Positive number of Rayon worker threads. This must be called before any Rayon use in the current Python process. If Rayon has already been initialized, a `RuntimeError` is raised.
